steps.en: OCMS receives summonses and charge sheets for approved applications
steps.id: OCMS menerima summons dan charge sheet untuk permohonan yang disetujui
steps.why_en: Nothing receives or reads files that State Courts would send back.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menerima atau membaca file yang dikirim balik State Courts.

steps.en: Summons numbers are updated on the notices
steps.why_en: Notices have no place to store a summons number.
steps.why_id: Notice tidak punya tempat untuk menyimpan nomor summons.

steps.en: Processing stage of notices is updated from the outcome
steps.id: Stage proses notice diperbarui sesuai hasil
steps.why_en: Stage can be written by another system, but not from the returned court outcome file.
steps.why_id: Stage bisa ditulis sistem lain, tetapi bukan dari file hasil court yang dikembalikan.

steps.en: Court mention details and approved or rejected flag are updated
steps.id: Detail mention court dan penanda disetujui atau ditolak diperbarui
steps.why_en: Neither mention details nor an approved or rejected flag are stored by the system.
steps.why_id: Sistem tidak menyimpan detail mention maupun penanda disetujui atau ditolak.

steps.en: A summary report of updated summonses is produced
steps.id: Laporan ringkasan summons yang diperbarui dihasilkan
steps.why_en: Report entries exist on the screen but nothing produces the report.
steps.why_id: Menu laporan ada di layar tetapi tidak ada yang menghasilkan laporannya.
